senses.def: A Moroccan doughnut or fritter made from fried dough and served plain or with sugar.
A short pulse of electromagnetic radiation produced by lightning
A proteolytic enzyme obtained from Bacillus sphaericus.
Electromagnetic pulses caused by atmospheric phenomena, such as lightning. plural of sferic
ex: A Sferics Locating System has been developed to determine the geographical location of lightning strokes...
...an artificial sferics generator was used as a known source of EM pulses.

senses.def: Radio interference caused by sferics; atmospherics.
A sparticle of the class of spin-0 superpartners of ordinary fermions appearing in supersymmetric extensions to the Standard Model.
